What is real — what we perceive or what actually exists?

In this lecture, Vishwajeet Sir explore the concept of reality through Immanuel Kant and Indian philosophical traditions, including Advaita Vedanta. Understand the distinction between phenomena and noumena, the limits of human knowledge, and the idea of transforming our perception to understand reality.

An insightful discussion for UPSC Philosophy Optional aspirants looking to build conceptual clarity and develop a deeper understanding of Western and Indian philosophy.
